description: Source code implementing fuel amount calculation logic for engine control, including functions for fuel injection timing, correction factors, and map initialization.

methods.name: getRealMafFuel
methods.description: Calculates total fuel duration based on airspeed and RPM, interpolating from fuel map.

methods.name: getBaseFuel
methods.description: Determines base fuel amount considering engine algorithm and enrichment.

methods.name: getInjectionOffset
methods.description: Calculates injection phase offset based on RPM and engine load.

methods.name: getNumberOfInjections
methods.description: Returns number of injections per engine cycle based on injection mode.

methods.name: getInjectorDutyCycle
methods.description: Calculates duty cycle percentage for injectors.

methods.name: getInjectionDuration
methods.description: Calculates duration of fuel injection per cycle, considering cranking state and injector lag.

methods.name: getRunningFuel
methods.description: Applies correction factors to base fuel for actual running conditions.

methods.name: getInjectorLag
methods.description: Calculates injector lag correction time based on battery voltage.

methods.name: initFuelMap
methods.description: Initializes fuel map data structures for interpolation.

methods.name: getCltFuelCorrection
methods.description: Provides fuel correction factor based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getCltTimingCorrection
methods.description: Provides timing correction based on coolant temperature.

methods.name: getIatFuelCorrection
methods.description: Provides fuel correction factor based on intake air temperature.

methods.name: getFuelCutOffCorrection
methods.description: Calculates fuel cut-off correction during coasting or other conditions.

methods.name: getBaseTableFuel
methods.description: Retrieves fuel injection duration from fuel map based on RPM and load.

methods.name: getBaroCorrection
methods.description: Provides correction factor based on barometric pressure.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel
methods.description: Calculates fuel duration during engine cranking.

methods.name: getCrankingFuel3
methods.description: Calculates cranking fuel duration based on coolant temperature, engine revolutions, and TPS.

methods.name: getFuelRate
methods.description: Calculates fuel flow rate based on injection duration and period.
